author: Inside Edition
description:
Hans Hamilton was driving when he saw what appeared to be a car accident and the driver passed out on the grass. When Hamilton pulled over to help the man, the man leaped up and smashed the good Samaritan's windshield. The man also repeatedly punched Hamilton. Hamilton spoke with Inside Edition. He says he is convinced the driver he went to help was trying to lure him into a trap. Cops say Daniel Coman has been charged with battery and assaulting a deputy sheriff who pulled up to the crash site.

Hamilton set up a GoFundMe to help with recovery costs. For further information about his GoFundMes, click this link: https://www.gofundme.com/f/help-hans-recover-after-attack
title: Good Samaritan Attacked By Man He Was Trying To Help
